response.summary: The console suffers from severe mobile viewport horizontal overflow and fails 11 accessibility criteria across ARIA semantics, labelling, navigation, and assistive styling.

findings.title: Mobile viewport horizontal overflow at 512px
findings.evidence: Audit responsive check reports width: 512, scrollWidth: 1023, overflow: true.
findings.fix: Add a media query in assets/styles.css allowing header, nav buttons, and .hdr-right to wrap, and set min-width: 0 on flex children to prevent fixed-width blowouts.
findings.acceptance: Automated viewport test at 512x768 reports document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= 512 with overflow: false.

findings.title: All form inputs lack accessible labels
findings.evidence: Audit a11y check input-labels failed with '13 inputs, 13 unlabelled'.
findings.fix: Add explicit <label for="..."> tags or aria-label attributes to all 13 <input> and <textarea> elements across index.html and app.js renderers.
findings.acceptance: Audit a11y check input-labels passes with 0 unlabelled inputs.

findings.title: Navigation tablist and tabpanel ARIA semantics are missing
findings.evidence: Audit a11y checks tablist-role, tab-roles, tabpanels, and aria-controls all fail for the 9-tab navigation.
findings.fix: Add role="tablist" to <nav id="nav">, role="tab" with aria-selected and aria-controls="tab-<id>" to nav buttons, and role="tabpanel" with aria-labelledby to each section.tab.
findings.acceptance: Audit a11y checks tablist-role, tab-roles, tabpanels, and aria-controls all evaluate to pass: true.

findings.title: Document lacks a top-level <h1> heading
findings.evidence: Audit a11y check single-h1 failed with '0 found'.
findings.fix: Change <div class="logo"> in index.html to <h1 class="logo"> to establish the required single primary heading.
findings.acceptance: Audit a11y check single-h1 evaluates to pass: true with exactly 1 <h1> found in DOM.

findings.title: Missing keyboard skip link to main content
findings.fix:
Add Skip to main content before
in index.html, id="main" to
, and style .skip-link in assets/styles.css to appear on :focus.
findings.acceptance: Audit a11y check skip-link evaluates to pass: true and Tab from initial focus navigates to #main.

findings.title: Toast message container is not an ARIA live region
findings.evidence: Audit a11y check live-region failed for #toast.
findings.fix: Add role="status" and aria-live="polite" attributes to <div id="toast"> in index.html.
findings.acceptance: Audit a11y check live-region evaluates to pass: true.

findings.title: Cloud SVG graph lacks accessible name and semantics
findings.fix: Add role="img" and aria-label="Dependency cloud graph" to <svg id="cloud"> in index.html.
findings.acceptance: Audit a11y check svg-semantics evaluates to pass: true.

findings.title: Missing CSS :focus-visible indicators and prefers-reduced-motion query
findings.evidence: Audit a11y checks focus-visible and reduced-motion both failed.
findings.fix: Add :focus-visible rules with high-contrast outlines for interactive elements and a @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) rule disabling animations and transitions in assets/styles.css.
findings.acceptance: Audit a11y checks focus-visible and reduced-motion both evaluate to pass: true.
